answer_1.quote: Fact-to-text (F2T) is a natural language generation (NLG) task where input is structured data (like facts) and output is its natural language description.
answer_1.outputs: natural language sentences capturing semantics from structured facts

answer_2.quote: We use overall BLEU scores for evaluating the multi-lingual models for English-Indic factsentence pairs. Following previous work, we also use METEOR and chrF++.

answer_4.quote: Finally, we obtain human annotations to evaluate the perceived quality of the generated text. Table 10 shows results for our best model across three metrics: fluency, coverage and hallucination in the generated output.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators used a 5-point Likert scale per metric.
